subject: Support running integration tests against an external Valkey server (#102)
reason: The change is a CI/test-infrastructure change only: it bumps the pinned valkey-test-framework commit in CMakeLists.txt, documents the new VALKEY_EXTERNAL_SERVER/VALKEY_HOST/VALKEY_PORT variables in README.md, and removes pkill cleanup from the integration-test runner script tst/integration/run.sh. No module source code, command behaviour, replies, persistence or replication paths are touched, so there is no runtime behaviour for a scenario to exercise.
